content_of_post_to_comment:
I spend 7 hours a day staring at my screen. Not it playing in the background or something, I mean my eyes are looking at my phone. I’m a stay at home dad and I’m missing years of my kids lives because I can’t stop myself. I feel like I’m going insane.

I’ve tried parental controls with the controls in the hands of my wife. I’ve switched to a flip phone. I downloaded different apps, tried screen covers to stop me from compulsively looking at my phone.

I’ve learned that if I have the ability to undo what I’ve done, I won’t stick with it. I can’t force myself to get off my phone unless I literally don’t have another option. I need something like when someone with a drug addiction is locked in a hospital to detox, where they literally can’t access drugs. But I don’t think something like that exists for phones.

I found a lockbox on Amazon. There are holes so I can answer calls or type on the keyboard, but I can’t see the screen otherwise. It’s battery powered and has a timer. Yes, there’s an emergency open mechanic, but it only allows you to do it five times per charge. So you’d have to let the battery die fully before doing it again, and this thing will stay charged for weeks. The only other option would be breaking it open.

I think this might work for me, but it feels ridiculous that I even need something like this to begin with. But do you think it’s worth a try?
